name: Guyana
headline: Guyana: +19.3% growth in 2025, 3.3% inflation, debt 29% of GDP
sections: Guyana is a $26.8 billion economy (2025), the world's 123rd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +19.3% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $98K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 1.9% of GDP (2025).

Consumer prices rose 3.3% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 6.9% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 12.0% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 24.9% (2025).
Gross government debt is 29% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 47% in 2020. The general government balance is −5.5% of GDP (2025), a deficit beyond the common 3% benchmark.
The current account balance is +21.4% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Net FDI inflows were 33.1% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 28% of GDP by 2031, broadly stable from today's level. Life expectancy is 70.3 years (2024). Population: 1.0 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
